body:
Inside the agent jail there is no systemd-run, systemctl or busctl, /proc/1 is bwrap, and the jail unshares pid and cgroup and runs with --die-with-parent. A session started here dies with the jail, and the scope path cannot be exercised at all.

Consequence for design: the launcher is data (an argv prefix), exactly as `dl-zmx-launcher` is in the elisp, and tests assert the argv it produces. End-to-end survival is a host-side manual check documented in the README, never a CI assertion. The parser and the view, which are most of the code, test fine here.
title: This jail cannot prove survival
